plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, John Dehner is credited on 533 distinct recordings across 21 programs from 1947-10-09 through 1979-06-25. Documented roles include performer on 529 recordings, writer on 3 recordings, and narrator on 2 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Gunsmoke (performer on 193 recordings; 193 distinct recordings), Have Gun, Will Travel (performer on 91 recordings; 91 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 64 recordings; 64 distinct recordings), Escape (performer on 46 recordings, writer on 3 recordings, and narrator on 2 recordings; 50 distinct recordings), Frontier Gentleman (performer on 26 recordings; 26 distinct recordings), The Whistler (performer on 18 recordings; 18 distinct recordings), Fort Laramie (performer on 16 recordings; 16 distinct recordings), and Suspense (performer on 13 recordings; 13 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Paladin (91 portrayals), J. B. Kendall (60 portrayals), and Captain Lee Quince (1 portrayals).
